name: litopys
description: litopys - long-term project memory for Claude Code, private by default.

plugins.name: litopys
plugins.description: Project memory for Claude Code: hooks keep a raw per-session journal without a model call, /litopys:distill turns it into session records, /litopys:recall answers from project history with refs. Everything it writes is git-ignored by default and re-checked every session.
